eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-04.latex:
\frac{d}{dt}\int_{KV(t)}\rho\vec c\,dV
+\int_{KP(t)}\rho\vec c\bigl[(\vec c-\vec v_{KP})\cdot\vec n\bigr]\,dA
=\sum\vec F.

eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-05.latex: \vec w_1 = \vec c_1 - \vec u, \qquad \dot m_{rel} = \rho A w_{1n}.

eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-06.latex:
\vec F_{okoline\to fluid} = \dot m_{rel}(\vec c_2 - \vec c_1),
\qquad
\vec F_{fluid\to lopaticu} = -\vec F_{okoline\to fluid}.

eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-optim.latex: F = \dot m\,(c_1 - u)(1 - \cos\beta_2) = \rho A c_1 (c_1 - u)(1 - \cos\beta_2),
\frac{dP}{du} = \rho A c_1 (1 - \cos\beta_2)\bigl[(c_1 - u) - u\bigr] = \rho A c_1 (1 - \cos\beta_2)(c_1 - 2u) = 0,

eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-euler.latex: \vec M = \dot m\,(\vec r_2 \times \vec c_2) - \dot m\,(\vec r_1 \times \vec c_1).

P_{r\to f}=\dot m\,(u_2c_{2t}-u_1c_{1t}),
\qquad
P_{f\to r}=\dot m\,(u_1c_{1t}-u_2c_{2t}).

eq-turbostrojevi-interaktivni-prikaz-tro.latex: F_p = \dot m(v_{izl} - v_{ul}) \approx \dot m v = \rho A v^2.

eq-turbostrojevi-matematicki-izvod-aktua.latex: F_p = \dot m\,(v_w - v_\infty) = \rho A v_d (v_w - v_\infty).
\rho A v_d (v_w - v_\infty) = \tfrac{1}{2}\rho A (v_w - v_\infty)(v_w + v_\infty),
F_p = \rho A v_d \cdot v_w = \rho A v_d \cdot 2 v_d = 2\rho A v_d^2.
